messages:
Harper CSM: Need a clipboard-ready 'mini-runbook' for onboarding that AEs can paste into kickoff notes. Must include: prefill, batching, streaming fallback, basic health checks, and renewal triggers. Keep it tiny.
Devon SE: Make two columns: customer-facing and ops knobs. Include explicit numbers.
Kai DevEx: I'll add two copy/paste snippets: prefill curl and a PromQL smoke check.
Zoe PM: Include a one-line SLA expectation to set customer expectations: p95 target and warm window.
Harper CSM: Customer line (paste): "We'll prefill top 8 intents; expect warm window ~10min and p95 < 800ms for ramp flows."
Devon SE: Ops knobs (copy): prefill_ttl=900s (increase to 1800s for long context), warm_pool=on for enterprise, burst_pool_ttl=300s, batch_target_tokens=1024 default.
Kai DevEx: Prefill curl (copy):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \\  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \\  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\  -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","intents":["intentA","intentB"],"ttl":900}'
```
Kai DevEx: PromQL smoke (copy):
```promql
100 * sum(rate(redwood_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(redwood_request_total[5m]))
```
Devon SE: Client pattern: add 0-200ms jitter + 2 retries; if stream error > 8% for 15m, fall back to non-streaming and open SE ticket.
Harper CSM: Renewal flags (copy): p95 > 1s sustained 24h, cache hit <40% for 48h, stream error >8% for 3 days, WoW cost spike >20%.
Zoe PM: AE email (paste): "We're seeing increased latency on your key flows. We're enabling extra warm capacity and will follow up with metrics in 24h."
NotifyBot: Confluence created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/mini-runbook-surge-play
Harper CSM: Great. I'll add to kickoff deck and share with the AE. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
